title: New law: Unfunded Mandates Reform Act of 1995 (Public Law 104-4)
summary: S. 1 of the 104th Congress became Public Law 104-4 on 1995-03-22.

title: New law: A bill to amend a provision of part A of title IX of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965, relating to Indian education, to provide a technical amendment, and for other purposes. (Public Law 104-5)
summary: S. 377 of the 104th Congress became Public Law 104-5 on 1995-03-23.

title: New law: A bill to amend the charter of the Veterans of Foreign Wars to make eligible for membership those veterans that have served within the territorial limits of South Korea. (Public Law 104-3)
summary: S. 257 of the 104th Congress became Public Law 104-3 on 1995-03-07.
